architecture.summary: The weekly organization sweep now clears organization_name when it deletes the tenant of an organization that WorkOS no longer has (2 November 2026): the registry keeps no name of a removed organization. The fleet command delete keeps the name, so the repair "delete, then request" gives the revived row the same service name. The shared removal of tenants takes the cause of the removal, organization-absent for the sweep and operator for the fleet command; the fleet store contract of tenants gains markDeletedWithoutOrganizationName, one more guarded UPDATE of the SQL adapter with the same start state and service as the delete of the operator (internalInterface). No column, migration, setting, grant, component, container, public module, dependency, or Mermaid view changes; the prose of the tenant registry view records the two delete statements and the cause.
